items.docs: Translates text using Neural Machine Translation (NMT). Accepts source and target language codes along with the text to translate. Supports Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, French, Spanish, Russian, German, and Italian — up to 5,000 characters per request.

Translates text using Statistical Machine Translation (SMT). Accepts source and target language codes and the text to translate. Supports Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).

params.name: query
params.description: Korean name in Hangul (UTF-8) to be romanized

items.docs: Converts a Korean name written in Hangul to its romanized Latin-script equivalent. Returns both the official romanization (following current Korean romanization rules) and statistically common romanizations.
